空き缶（飲料・食料用以外）: Empty can (other than beverage/food; excluding aerosol cans and gas canisters)
空き瓶（飲料・食品用以外）: Empty glass bottle (non-food: cosmetics, perfume, non-oral medicines etc.; excluding chemical and pesticide bottles)
充電器・充電コード: Charger / charging cable (excluding power banks / mobile batteries)
電化製品: Electrical appliances (excluding TVs, washing machines, air conditioners, refrigerators/freezers, clothes dryers, PCs, dehumidifiers and devices with non-removable batteries)
びん（薬品等、その他）: Glass bottle (non-oral medicines etc., other; excluding chemical and pesticide bottles)
ルーレット: Roulette (ruretto; roulette wheel or tracing wheel)
びん（飲料用、食料用）: Glass bottle (beverage, food; excluding returnable beer bottles)
